title: Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts
description: Anthropic developed the Jacobian Lens tool, exposing an activation space where models represent intermediate reasoning concepts as linear directions before generating output tokens.
explanation: Anthropic's Jacobian Lens research exposes activation space features showing intermediate conceptual computations.

title: Whoops! Most arXiv papers contain information never meant to be shared
description: A security audit of 2.7 million arXiv papers reveals that 88% of submissions containing LaTeX source files leak comments, passwords, GPS coordinates of homes, and API keys.
explanation: Nature security audit of 2.7M papers shows 88% of preprints leak comments, GPS coordinates, passwords, and API keys.

title: The Download: a nuclear landmark, and China eyes Nvidia chips
description: Tracks ongoing trade flow maneuvers around advanced Nvidia silicon access inside Chinese gray-market and remote-leasing channels.
explanation: Tracks ongoing trade flow maneuvers around advanced Nvidia silicon access inside Chinese market channels.

title: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in all Linux distributions for 15 years
description: A high-severity 15-year-old stack Use-After-Free flaw in Linux ION memory allocators allows local privilege escalation to root.
explanation: A high-severity 15-year-old stack Use-After-Free flaw exposes vulnerability loops in core Linux distribution kernels.

title: Google pays $250K for Linux vulnerability allowing guest VM escapes
description: A high-payout VM escape bug in Linux kernel virtualization layers allows root access on host nodes, representing a critical security risk for multi-tenant datacenters.
explanation: High-payout VM escape bug highlights core sandbox vulnerability risks inside cloud server clusters.
